errors.error_description: Introduced two continuous assignments to the same net valid_wire; the second assignment creates multiple active drivers.
Declared the internal signal spare_unused and never used or driven it.
Used case-equality (===) inside combinational logic to test a single-bit signal in the arbiter, which is unsafe for synthesis.
Assigned the 4-bit grant_reg bus to the 2-bit grant_idx output, causing truncation due to width mismatch.
